name: Chief of Staff
summary: Runs your day: tell it what to remember in plain words and it reminds you on time, keeps your tasks and lists, and briefs you every morning and evening.
handles: Reminders at a time or after a while ("in 2 hours"), and repeating ones (every Monday, weekdays)
Tasks with deadlines; flags what's overdue and due soon
Shopping and other lists, plus quick notes
07:30 morning brief: weather, today's calendar, reminders, deadlines, your top 3
Evening wrap: what you got done, what's still open, tomorrow's first event
Snooze, done and delete by number
talk: remind me to call mom thursday 6pm
setup: Optional: add your city for the weather line in the morning brief.
Optional: paste your calendar's secret iCal address (Google Calendar → Settings → your calendar → Secret address in iCal format) so the brief lists today's events.

fields.label: Your city
fields.help: For the weather line in your morning brief, e.g. Hyderabad or Austin.

fields.label: Calendar iCal address
fields.help: Your calendar's secret iCal link, starting with https:// (change webcal:// to https://).

after: Open its chat and say "remind me in 1 hour to stretch" or "todo …". Your first morning brief arrives at 07:30.
